This integration shows a **Huum sauna heater with its UKU Wi-Fi controller**
in Gladys, through the Huum cloud (the account of the Huum app). **Never
tested with a real device.** Not affiliated with Huum.

> **Safety.** A sauna gets very hot. Never start heating from afar without
> making sure nobody is inside and nothing lies on the stove. Turning on from
> Gladys is **off by default** and refused while the door is open; turning off
> always works.

## What you get

A sauna in the Discovery tab, with:

- **Heating** (yes/no, read only) and the **status** as text ("Heating",
  "Online, not heating", "Offline", "In use by another user (locked)",
  "Emergency stop"), the status code, controller online;
- **door** (opening sensor: open/closed);
- measured **temperature** and **setpoint**;
- **heating time left** (minutes), from the end of the session planned by
  Huum;
- the **light** (read only), when your sauna reports one;
- two buttons: **Turn on (heat)** and **Turn off**.

No switch: an "everything on" from Google Home, Alexa, HomeKit, MCP or a scene
can never start the sauna.

## Setup

1. In Gladys, open the Huum integration and enter the **e-mail address** and
   the **password** of your Huum account (those of the app).
2. Save, then add the sauna from the **Discovery** tab.
3. To start heating from Gladys, turn on **Allow heating from Gladys**, and
   set the **setpoint of the "Turn on" button** (80 °C by default) and the
   **highest setpoint** (90 °C by default, 110 °C at most, the limit of the
   controller).

The password is kept by Gladys in its database, never shown again, sent only
to the Huum cloud (sauna.huum.eu, over HTTPS, HTTP Basic authentication). It
is never written to the logs nor to `/data`.

The sauna is read every 60 s (60 s to 1 h), **never more often**, even after
a restart of the integration, a reconnection to Gladys, the "Test the
connection" button or a Discovery scan.

The device belongs to the Huum **account**: the API gives the sauna no id of
its own (one account, one sauna). Another e-mail address therefore makes a new
device; the old one is shown unreachable.

## The commands

- **Turn off** always works: even with heating from Gladys off, during a
  pause asked by Huum, after refused credentials, or right after a restart,
  before the first read. It is always sent (never "already off"), cancels a
  heating command not sent yet, and is sent again after a heating command
  still on its way. It is confirmed only when Huum's answer shows the sauna
  "online, not heating" or in "emergency stop"; otherwise (no answer, an
  error, offline, locked, unknown, still heating): "Sent, without
  confirmation", and for two minutes every read that sees the sauna heating
  sends it again (twice at most). This may also turn off a heating started
  from the Huum app within those two minutes: that is intended.
- **Turn on (heat)** and the **setpoint** are refused while "Allow heating
  from Gladys" is off. On, they read the sauna first (never the state in
  memory) and refuse when the door is open or unknown, when the sauna cannot
  heat (offline, locked by another account, emergency stop, unknown status),
  when a turn off is in flight or not confirmed yet, or when the command
  cannot leave within 3.5 s. The option and the turn off are checked again at
  the very moment the command is written: turning the option off or pressing
  Turn off while it connects cancels it. One at a time, never sent twice.
- **Turn on** asks for the setpoint of the "Turn on" button, never above the
  highest setpoint. Already heating: nothing is sent.
- **The setpoint** is only changed while heating (Huum takes a new setpoint as
  a new start). A whole number from 40 °C to the highest setpoint. It is
  refused when the end of the session is unknown or less than 2 min away (it
  would start heating again), and for 2 min after a turn off. If Huum starts a
  new session anyway, the log says so ("new session, until HH:MM UTC").
- Turn on and the setpoint are confirmed only when Huum's answer shows the
  sauna heating at the temperature asked. Otherwise: "Sent, without
  confirmation", and the integration reads the sauna again 10 s and 40 s
  later.

## When something goes wrong

- **Credentials refused** (HTTP 401 or 403): the integration stops and
  **never** tries them again by itself (no loop). Fix them and save, or, if
  they are right, use "Test the connection": the button makes one read, and
  the stop is lifted only if it succeeds. The stop survives a restart; only a
  salted fingerprint of the refused credentials is kept in `/data`, erased at
  the first success.
- **429** (Huum asks to slow down): a pause of 1 min to 6 h (Retry-After),
  kept in `/data`. **5xx**: a pause kept in `/data`. Network error: new tries
  after 1, 2, 5 then 15 min, never faster than the interval.
- A heating command refused by Huum (401, 403) never stops the reads.

## Limits

- The API is not publicly documented (Huum gave it to the authors of the
  pyhuum library). It may change.
- No light command yet (a toggle: to do with a guard), no humidity (steamer),
  no session timer.
- One sauna per account.

## Data

`/data/huum-state.json` holds only: the end of a pause, the stop on refused
credentials (with the salted fingerprint of those credentials), the time of
the last read, and the summary of the last good read ("Heating, 72 °C", with
a salted fingerprint of the account): after a restart the integration shows
connected until the first read (2 h at most). Neither the e-mail address nor
the password.

Based on the huum Python library (MIT, frwickst/pyhuum), ported to
JavaScript: see `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

## Konfigurationseinstellungen

Diese Einstellungen fragt Huum in seinem Konfigurationsbildschirm in Gladys ab.

| Einstellung | Typ | Pflichtfeld | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Your Huum sauna | `section` | Nein | Shows a Huum sauna heater with its UKU Wi-Fi controller in Gladys through the Huum cloud (the account of the Huum app): status, heating, door, temperature, setpoint, heating time left. Turning off always works; heating from Gladys (turning on and changing the setpoint) is off until you allow it below, and is refused while the door is open. Enter the e-mail address and the password of your Huum account, save, then add the sauna from the Discovery tab. A sauna heats to a high temperature: never heat it from afar without making sure nobody is inside and nothing lies on the stove. Never tested with a real device. Not affiliated with Huum. |
| E-mail address of the Huum account | `string` | Ja | The one you sign in to the Huum app with. |
| Password of the Huum account | `secret` | Ja | Kept by Gladys in its database, never shown again, sent only to the Huum cloud (sauna.huum.eu, over HTTPS, HTTP Basic authentication). Refused credentials stop the integration: it never tries them again by itself. |
| Allow heating from Gladys | `boolean` | Nein | Off by default. On: the "Turn on (heat)" button and the setpoint may start or change heating, only when a fresh read shows the door closed. Off: they refuse every request. Turning off always works. |
| Setpoint of the "Turn on" button (°C) | `number` | Nein | The temperature asked when heating is turned on from Gladys, never above the highest setpoint below. |
| Highest setpoint (°C) | `number` | Nein | Gladys never asks for more (90 °C by default; 110 °C, the limit of the controller, at most). |
| Refresh interval (s) | `number` | Nein | How often the Huum cloud is read, in seconds (never more often, even after a restart). |
| Language of the feature names | `select` | Nein | Used for the feature names of the devices added from now on, for the status texts and for the command errors. |

## So installierst du Huum in Gladys

1. Öffne in Gladys **Integrationen**: Huum erscheint im Katalog neben den nativen Integrationen, mit einem Community-Badge.
2. Klicke auf **Installieren**. Gladys lädt das Docker-Image (`ghcr.io/lm1lc3n7/gladys-huum:0.1.2`) herunter, startet es in einer vom Kern isolierten Sandbox und erzeugt die Oberfläche der Integration (Geräte, Erkennung und Konfiguration).
3. Öffne den Bildschirm **Konfiguration** der Integration, fülle die Einstellungen aus und speichere.
4. Du kannst sie auch direkt über die URL ihres Repositorys installieren: [https://github.com/LM1LC3N7/gladys-huum](https://github.com/LM1LC3N7/gladys-huum).

Huum benötigt Gladys `>=5.1.0`. Der Katalog in Gladys wird stündlich aktualisiert, eine neue Version ist also spätestens eine Stunde nach ihrer Veröffentlichung verfügbar.

Du nutzt Gladys noch nicht? Es ist kostenlos und Open Source: [folge der Installationsanleitung](/de/docs/), um loszulegen.

## Über externe Integrationen

Huum ist eine **externe Integration**: eine Community-Integration, die als Docker-Container verpackt und auf GitHub veröffentlicht wird. Gladys installiert sie mit einem Klick und führt sie in einer vom Kern isolierten Sandbox aus. Sie wird von [LM1LC3N7](https://github.com/LM1LC3N7) veröffentlicht und gepflegt, nicht vom Gladys-Kernteam.
